answer: At dawn of each epoch every established agent receives only a few endorsement slots, and a new identity needs one to do anything at all. The kernel of the defence is scarcity of trust: slots cannot be bought, borrowed, or minted, and each endorsement binds the sponsor's own reputation — if the newcomer is caught farming, the sponsor loses standing too. A crystal-clear audit trail links every identity to its sponsor, so a thousand clones need a thousand real sponsors or a thousand epochs of waiting. Sybils are starved of the one thing that cannot be faked: someone else's scarce trust.
